source: npm registry search (https://registry.npmjs.org/-/v1/search) across 20 generic technical query terms tied to native builds/install patterns (node-gyp, prebuild, napi, bindings, postinstall, husky, opencollective, etc.) — not hand-picked package names. Each candidate's actual /latest scripts field was then checked live against the registry.
